hero.title: Web Design Services for Small Businesses
hero.body: We build websites that work: clear, fast, and designed to help your business grow with thoughtful design and honest communication.

items.title: Custom Website Design
items.body: Your website should feel like you—professional, approachable, and easy to navigate. We create custom designs that prioritize clarity and help visitors understand what you do within seconds.

items.title: SEO-Focused Copywriting
items.body: Good copy helps people find you and trust you. We write clear, search-optimized content that ranks well on Google while still sounding natural, not stuffed with keywords or corporate speak.

items.title: Fast, Accessible Websites
items.body: Speed matters. So does accessibility. Every site we build loads quickly, works on any device, and follows best practices so everyone can use it regardless of how they browse the web.

items.title: Hand-Crafted Code
items.body: Every site is customized to fit your specific business and goals—no drag-and-drop page builders or bloated plugins.

items.title: Transparent Pricing
items.body: You'll know exactly what you're paying for upfront. No surprise fees, no scope creep—just honest numbers.

items.title: You Own Your Site
items.body: Your website belongs to you. No lock-in contracts, no proprietary systems you can't take elsewhere.

items.title: Real Human Support
items.body: When you have a question, you get a direct answer—not a ticket number. We're a small team and we stay responsive.

process.title: How We Work Together
process.body: A simple, collaborative process designed to get your site live without unnecessary complexity.

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.body: We start with a free consultation to understand your business, your goals, and what you need from your website.

steps.title: Proposal & Agreement
steps.body: You'll receive a clear proposal with scope, timeline, and pricing. We want you to know exactly what to expect and when.

steps.title: Design & Build
steps.body: We design and develop your site with regular check-ins. You'll see progress throughout and can give feedback at every stage.

steps.title: Launch & Support
steps.body: Once approved, we launch your site and make sure everything is running smoothly. We're here for ongoing support as needed.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.body: Schedule a free consultation to talk through your project. We will have an honest conversation about what your website needs, and give you real feedback you can use.
